movelist.name: Screech
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Defense lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Thunder Wave
movelist.effect: Thunder Wave Paralyzes the target. Targets immune to Electric Attacks are immune to Thunder Wave’s effects.

movelist.name: String Shot
movelist.effect: Targets have their Speed CS lowered by -1. If this lowers their Speed CS to -6, or if their Speed CS was already at -6, the target is instead Stuck.

movelist.name: Spider Web
movelist.effect: Spider Web cannot miss. The target is Stuck and Trapped. If the user is freed of the Stuck condition, they are freed of Trapped as well.

movelist.name: Leech Life
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains HP equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

abilities.name: Unnerve
abilities.effect: The target cannot gain positive Combat Stages or trade in Digestion Buffs for 1 full round.
